rapport_notes: Jeline is patient, friendly, and clear throughout; good pacing and natural conversational tone; no friction or awkwardness.
process_discipline_notes: No differentiators repeated; no rule violations detected on silence/open-ended follow-up structure.

evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: Rep launches straight into address confirmation ('Let me just confirm pickup address') with no framing of the ask or time-boxed promise of an accurate quote in return.
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: Asked at 6:25 min mark: 'I'll just put here, okay, before I go over the pricing structure and your estimate, do you have any concern about the moving process.' This is after extensive logistics probing (boxes, parking distances, furniture, appliances). Customer answers 'No.' No follow-up to unearth unstated concerns.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Customer raised no concerns (answered 'No' to the only agenda question), so no follow-up opportunity existed. N/A per rubric exception — concern never raised.
evidence_quotes.sheet1_careful_with: Never asked. No mention of damage coverage, care, or 'we move it like it's ours' framing.
evidence_quotes.sheet2_whos_coming: Never asked. No mention of crew lead or 'Meet Your Mover.'
evidence_quotes.on_time_guarantee: Never mentioned anywhere in the call.
evidence_quotes.communication: Never mentioned. No day-before call, crew lead name, or inbox updates discussed.
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: Rep provides anchor + personalization: 'since we're coming from a second floor apartment with stair access, only going to afford floor with elevator access. And both location have a long walk. I will estimate this move to finish in four hours to five hours with two movers and one truck.'
evidence_quotes.estimate_is_a_window: Rep says: 'If ever the move takes less than this you will only be charged for how much time we use during the move. It's just that with my estimate, I added a buffer since I'm assuming that those locations have a really long Walker.'
evidence_quotes.beats_it_pay_less: Rep says: 'if you are really ready by tomorrow like the movers will just focus unloading everything into the truck. Then, that would really help keep the timezone. So, obviously the last time would take the less money end up spending at the end of the day.'
evidence_quotes.self_prep_tip: Implicit self-prep tip: 'if you are really ready by tomorrow like the movers will just focus unloading everything into the truck' — not explicitly framed as 'anything you get done before we show up comes off your bill,' but the concept is there.
evidence_quotes.does_that_feel_fair_then_silence: Rep never asks 'does that feel fair?' or any equivalent close-check open-ended question before moving to close.
evidence_quotes.rate_lock: Rep never mentions rate locks or that the rate locks at booking.
evidence_quotes.close_explicit_ask: Rep asks 'should we schedule you for tomorrow?' (soft ask), customer agrees, then rep moves to confirmation. No explicit 'would you like our help with your move?' or equivalent tie-down.

top_strength: Jeline thoroughly and methodically captured all logistics details (distances, furniture, floor access, box count) and delivered a confident, personalized estimate with a clear price range and arrival window — the foundational nuts and bolts were executed cleanly.
coaching_note: Lead with a quid pro quo framing before probing ('I'll ask you a few questions to build an accurate quote — should take about 6 minutes'), ask for their agenda *before* launching into logistics, and never skip the differentiators (damage coverage, Meet Your Mover, On-Time Guarantee, Communication) — cover them either in Stage 1 if a customer raises a concern, or as your Stage 2 takeaway pitch before closing.
